title: Controlled Heterometallic Composition in Linear Trinuclear [LnCeLn] Lanthanide Molecular Assemblies

synthesis.procedure: Heterometallic [HoCeHo] was obtained from reactions in pyridine of H2LA with Ce(NO3)3/Ho(NO3)3 mixtures in a 1:2 molar ratio. Slow diffusion of hexane into the resulting orange solutions afforded orange oils that turned into orange crystals after several weeks. A more rational synthesis used Ce(NO3)3 and Ho(NO3)3 (1:2 molar ratio) with two equivalents of H2LA and H2LB in pyridine; addition of CuCl2 aided crystallization, with crystals of [Cu(py)4(NO3)2] forming first, followed by large single crystals of 1 that could be separated from the oil. Quantitative experimental details are referred to the SI experimental section.

reagents.name: cerium(III) nitrate
reagents.amount: 1 molar equivalent relative to Ho(NO3)3 at 1:2 Ce:Ho

synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot reaction in pyridine followed by hexane vapor/slow diffusion crystallization; CuCl2-assisted crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hexane diffusion into orange pyridine solutions gave orange oils that crystallized over several weeks. In the CuCl2-assisted procedure, [Cu(py)4(NO3)2] crystals form first and are separated from subsequent large crystals of 1.

properties.summary: Bulk magnetometry of polycrystalline 1 shows a room-temperature χMT of 26.4 cm3 K mol-1, slightly below the 28.1 cm3 K mol-1 expected for uncoupled CeIII (2F5/2) plus two HoIII (5I8) ions. χMT decreases on cooling, attributed to Stark-level depopulation plus weak intra- and/or intermolecular magnetic interactions. No optical photophysical measurements are reported.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; polycrystalline sample; per [HoCeHo] unit

The rational route used Ce(NO3)3 and Er(NO3)3 (1:2) with two equivalents of H2LA and H2LB in pyridine, plus CuCl2 to promote crystallization of 2 after prior formation of [Cu(py)4(NO3)2]. Quantitative experimental details are referred to the SI experimental section.
